protocol.path: Native forward action2 repeated size-3 times, from x1 east to fork center
protocol.intervention: Swap key/ball cue only; retain branch objects and original stored reward goals
protocol.policy_inputs: Partial observation, previous forced action and causal recurrent state
protocol.current_control: Exact hidden-state and policy equality wherever current observations are identical
protocol.interpretation: Cue-dependent state retention and output sensitivity, not task performance or decoded memory

limitations: Forced actions bypass the policy, so this is not learned-policy performance
A nonzero state difference does not prove decodable or usable memory
Unchanged argmax can coexist with changed action probabilities
This is a posthoc mechanism diagnostic on separately declared probe worlds
